title: 4. Incidents & Reliability
description: Incident lifecycle, alert delivery and gate history - the evidence trail behind every closed incident.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT severity AS metric, count(*) AS value
                    FROM incidents
                    WHERE status IN ('OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED','SUPPRESSED')
                    GROUP BY severity
                    ORDER BY CASE severity
                        WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

panels.title: Oldest live incident
panels.description: By severity. A CRITICAL that has been open for days is the story.

panels.title: Alert deliveries by outcome
panels.description: `duplicate` proves the receiver is deduplicating retries rather than handling one alert many times. `failed` means a delivery was attempted and recorded as lost, not silently dropped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM alert_deliveries GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

panels.title: Incidents
panels.description: `occurrences` rising with no new alert means the cooldown is working. A RESOLVED incident always carries the note recording how many verified healthy measurements closed it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.incident_id AS "id", d.dataset_name AS "dataset",
                           i.detector AS "detector", i.severity AS "severity",
                           i.status AS "status", i.occurrence_count AS "occurrences",
                           i.first_seen_at AS "first_seen",
                           i.last_seen_at AS "last_seen",
                           COALESCE(i.resolution_note, '-') AS "resolution",
                           left(i.title, 60) AS "title"
                    FROM incidents i JOIN datasets d USING (dataset_id)
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE i.status WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                        CASE i.severity
                            WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 1
                            WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
                        i.last_seen_at DESC
                    LIMIT 100

panels.title: Incident lifecycle events
panels.description: The audit trail. HEALTHY_CHECK rows are the positive evidence a resolution requires - an incident is never closed because its alert went quiet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.occurred_at AS "when", e.incident_id AS "incident",
                           e.event_type AS "event",
                           COALESCE(e.from_status, '-') AS "from",
                           COALESCE(e.to_status, '-') AS "to",
                           e.actor AS "actor", left(e.detail, 90) AS "detail"
                    FROM incident_events e
                    WHERE $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at)
                    ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC
                    LIMIT 150

panels.title: Gate decisions over time
panels.description: Every PASS, PASS_WITH_WARNINGS and FAIL the gate has made.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT g.decided_at AS time, g.decision AS metric,
                           1 AS value
                    FROM gate_decisions g
                    WHERE $__timeFilter(g.decided_at)
                    ORDER BY g.decided_at

panels.description: How long the quality checks themselves take.
